name: Paul Alexander Cline
biography: Steven Cline's older brother. Born in Budapest, Hungary, he emigrated to the US as a small child with his mother and brother, and later settled in Ohio. He married Jewel Cline; family pages also mention Hattie, Bobby, Cliff, and Sandra Kay Cline alongside him, though their exact relation isn't specified. He died June 26, 2000 in Parma, OH.
